pages.text: Garlic can be found in Taiga biomes as Wild Garlic.$(br)When provided to a Mechanical Saw, Garlic Bulbs can be turned into Minced Garlic.
Garlic Bread can be made by mixing together Bread, Milk, Leaves, and Minced Garlic inside of a heated basin.
Crystalline Garlic can be made by surrounding a piece of Garlic with Nether Quartz in a diamond formation.$(br)This can also be turned into Minced Crystalline Garlic to be used later.
